info.name: WISK API
info.description: WISK is a bar/restaurant/hospitality inventory and cost-management platform. WISK does not publish a public, self-serve developer portal, a public base URL, or an official OpenAPI specification. The only publicly documented programmatic surface is a partner-gated Public Sales upload flow for POS providers to push sales data into WISK customer accounts; customer API access is offered on the Premium plan. This collection documents that surface honestly - no base URL, endpoints, or authentication are fabricated. The {{baseUrl}} variable is left empty pending values obtained through WISK's partner integration / Premium API enablement.

item.name: POS Integration (Partner)
item.description: Partner-gated Public Sales upload. POS providers contact WISK partnerships to obtain the actual endpoint, base URL, and authentication. Documented data fields: POS code (or item name), quantity sold, net sales. Request below is a non-authoritative template; the real path/URL is not publicly published.

item.name: Public Sales Upload (template - not publicly documented)

request.description: Template only. WISK's Public Sales upload endpoint URL and authentication are provided through the partner integration process and are not publicly published. Fields shown (pos_code/item_name, quantity_sold, net_sales) are the documented sales-data requirements.

variable.description: Not publicly published by WISK; obtained via partner integration / Premium API enablement.
